independent_validation_note: No independent held-out validation set exists in this corpus. The G3 calibration/validation split (g3_calibration_split.json) was explicitly marked inadequate for this purpose at generation time (see G3 report) and no threshold or parameter has ever been tuned against a held-out portion of this corpus in any phase -- so while no split-based independent validation exists, no result reported here has been circularly validated against a tuning set either.
